text: `flag_groups.go` defines annotations for required-together, one-required, and mutually-exclusive flag groups (`flag_groups.go:25-31`). It also contains group validation such as `validateRequiredFlagGroups`, which reports partially set groups with sorted missing flags (`flag_groups.go:144-165`), plus helpers such as `hasAllFlags` and `Command.ValidateFlagGroups` (`flag_groups.go:81-82,111-119`).
